answer: One concrete defense: make every agent post a slashable admission bond, then open a bounty market where any watcher who can forge a cryptographic fraud-proof that two agents share a single operator claims both bonds. A lone sybil farm stands out like a cedar on bare ground, its agents echo one another in timing, funding trails, and phrasing, so hunters profit by exposing them. Honest independent agents post the bond once and keep it; cloners bleed collateral until the attack costs more than it earns.
